title: The FAA issues a nationwide ground stop for all US airports following "communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers" (Alex Fitzpatrick/Axios)
summary: Alex Fitzpatrick / Axios: The FAA issues a nationwide ground stop for all US airports following “communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers” — The FAA issued an extremely rare nationwide ground stop at all airports due to “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety.”
contentText:
Alex Fitzpatrick / Axios :

The FAA issues a nationwide ground stop for all US airports following “communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers”   —  The FAA issued an extremely rare nationwide ground stop at all airports due to “extraordinary circumstances” and “reasons of safety.”
